clue.text: Wise man — inside, a very cruel man

indicators.note: the words after 'inside' are placed within the wise man's letters

parts.note: a sage is a wise man

explanation.surface: A sage harbours a vicious streak within him.
explanation.definitionFit: A savage is a brutal, ferocious person, fitting a cruel man.

clue.text: Discharge cargo, a large amount

parts.note: to shed is to let go or discharge
a load is a cargo

explanation.surface: Unloading the freight, quite a lot of it.
explanation.definitionFit: A shedload is informal British slang for a great quantity.

clue.text: Seductive females a politician's seen after five

indicators.note: the politician comes after five in the answer

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral five
MP is a Member of Parliament; with the 's, MPS

explanation.surface: Temptresses accompanying a politician after a five o'clock appointment.
explanation.definitionFit: A vamp is a woman who uses her charms to seduce men.

clue.text: Vague person acting as leader

explanation.definitionFit: General means not detailed; a general is a senior army commander.

clue.text: Exclusive miss entering Diplomatic Corps

parts.note: CD is the abbreviation for Corps Diplomatique, the diplomatic corps
to miss is to lose, as a chance

explanation.surface: A young woman joins the circle of diplomats, a select group.
explanation.walkthrough: 'miss' looks like a young woman, but it is the verb meaning to fail to get.
explanation.definitionFit: A closed club or shop is exclusive, open only to members.

clue.text: Siren in mythology with garland on

parts.note: lore is traditional myth and legend
a lei is a Hawaiian flower garland

explanation.surface: A mythical temptress wearing a wreath.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lorelei is the Rhine maiden of German legend whose song lured boatmen onto the rocks.
explanation.definitionFit: The Lorelei is a siren figure who lured sailors with her singing.

clue.text: Like close-fitting attire that could make knight sit awkwardly

indicators.note: sitting awkwardly suggests the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A knight in tight clothes would struggle to sit down.
explanation.definitionFit: Skintight clothing clings closely to the body.

clue.text: Evil spirit moaned terribly

indicators.note: done terribly, the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A ghoul groaned dreadfully.
explanation.definitionFit: A daemon is a demon, a malign spirit.

clue.text: End period of education in America

parts.note: a school or university term is a period of teaching
US is the United States

explanation.surface: The close of a school term in the United States.
explanation.definitionFit: A terminus is the end point of a line or route, so the word can mean an end.

clue.text: Stars as guitarist in new arrangement

indicators.note: the words are rearranged, like a musical piece re-scored

explanation.surface: Pop stars treated as a guitarist in a fresh musical arrangement.
explanation.definitionFit: Sagittarius is a constellation, a group of stars.

clue.text: Attacker's assistant grabbed by bishop

indicators.note: the assistant is held within the bishop's letters, a container signal

parts.note: RR, Right Reverend, is the title abbreviation used for a bishop
an aide is an assistant

explanation.surface: An attacker's helper is seized by a churchman.
explanation.walkthrough: A bishop is styled the Right Reverend, abbreviated RR. The 's after 'Attacker' stands for 'is'.
explanation.definitionFit: A raider is someone who makes a sudden attack, an attacker.

clue.text: Additional fabric that's soft, not hard

parts.note: plush is a soft fabric with a long nap
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Extra material that is soft rather than stiff.
explanation.definitionFit: Plus as an adjective means extra or additional, as in a plus factor.

clue.text: Lout in rage breaking law

indicators.note: the letters of the phrase are broken up and rearranged

explanation.surface: A furious yob breaks the law.
explanation.definitionFit: A regulation is a rule or law laid down by authority.

clue.text: What you get in the argument is extremely loud

definitions.text: What you get in the argument
definitions.meaning: a heated row assaults the hearer's ears with noise

explanation.surface: A shouting match produces a deafening din.
explanation.walkthrough: The first part is cryptic: an argument at full volume leaves your ears feeling split.
explanation.definitionFit: Ear-splitting describes a noise so loud it seems to hurt the ears.

clue.text: Being inefficient, stay relatively still

definitions.meaning: move less, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Shiftless describes someone idle and lacking ambition, hence ineffective.

clue.text: See storm brewing in area around Chard

indicators.note: a storm brewing is gathering, and the letters are stirred up

explanation.surface: Watch the weather turn in the country near Chard.
explanation.walkthrough: Chard is a market town in Somerset, a county in south-west England; it is not the vegetable.
explanation.definitionFit: Somerset is the English county in which the town of Chard lies.

clue.text: Equipment in office, everything fitting in

indicators.note: everything is fitted into the office, a container signal

parts.note: a station is a post or office someone holds
all means everything

explanation.surface: Gear in the office, with everything slotted into place.
explanation.walkthrough: 'office' here is a post or position held, as in a station in life; 'fitting in' is the container signal.
explanation.definitionFit: An installation is machinery or equipment set up for use, such as a heating plant.

clue.text: Tree worship being performed

definitions.meaning: the ... tree is a European tree related to the rowan

explanation.definitionFit: The service tree is a sorb; a service is a religious ceremony.

clue.text: Support friend without running the risk of prosecution

definitions.text: without running the risk of prosecution

parts.note: a leg supports a table
an ally is a friend

explanation.surface: Back a mate, staying within the law.

clue.text: Outspoken when there's mess around city area

parts.note: dirt is mess
EC is the postcode for the City of London

clue.text: Frightening bird with gun — it's horrible

indicators.note: a horrible mess of the letters signals a rearrangement

parts.note: taken as its letters, without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A bird facing a gun is a horrible sight.

clue.text: Breathed hard, making unhappy sound

indicators.note: the clue says we want the sound of the word for unhappy

parts.note: feeling blue is feeling sad

explanation.surface: Someone panting, letting out a mournful noise.
explanation.definitionFit: Blew is the past tense of blow, to puff out air hard.

clue.text: Graduate getting to study artist

clue.text: Arab chaps you and I may hug

clue.text: Only Conservative docrine that's seen as mistake

parts.note: sole means only

clue.text: One examining old coin found in part of bed

definitions.meaning: the canopy over a four-poster bed

explanation.definitionFit: A tester is one who tries things out, an examiner.

clue.text: Sound of seal or young bird

parts.note: a signet is a seal, as on a ring
